## [What arrives, and what must be asked for](../gmail.md#what-arrives-and-what-must-be-asked-for)

## [Messages](../gmail.md#messages)

- **GM-2** — a sent message matching no action on a tracked thread is a defect; on an untracked thread an ordinary record; spam yields no task; a reply from the addressed party closes nothing by itself *[M]*

## [Conditions that are not delivered at all](../gmail.md#conditions-that-are-not-delivered-at-all)

- **GM-4** — a bounce is an observation, never a confirmation reversal *[M]*

## [Outbound: the operations the workflows take on the mail system](../gmail.md#outbound-the-operations-the-workflows-take-on-the-mail-system)

- **GM-5** — send read back by message id; the key on the reviewed body's digest; a follow-up's thread id equals the batch's; no recovery row *[M]*

- **GM-7** — the same: an unconfirmed key is reconciled by reading the sent folder before any resend *[M]*

## [A thread and its messages are each artifacts, related by `PART_OF`](../gmail.md#a-thread-and-its-messages-are-each-artifacts-related-by-part_of)

- **GM-9** — both levels are artifacts; a history entry lands on the message, minted `PART_OF` its thread; a send's confirmation mints the message `PART_OF` the thread; a sign-off on a thread pins the message set the read returned with its coverage; a regrouped message ends one edge and writes another, never a re-identification *[M]*
